subsection.content: There shall be allowed as a deduction all the ordinary and necessary expenses paid or incurred during the taxable year in carrying on any trade or business, including a reasonable allowance for salaries or other compensation for personal services actually rendered.

Except as provided in this subsection, no deduction otherwise allowable shall be allowed for any amount paid or incurred to, or at the direction of, a government or governmental entity in relation to the violation of any law.

section.heading: Disallowance of certain entertainment, etc., expenses

subsection.content: No deduction otherwise allowable under this chapter shall be allowed for any item with respect to an activity which is of a type generally considered to constitute entertainment, amusement, or recreation.
The amount allowable as a deduction for any expense for food or beverages shall not exceed 50 percent of the amount of such expense.
